get.description: Lists all routings of an account, optionally filtered by payment method. Each item has the same shape as Retrieve a Routing.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Account to list routings for. Must belong to the organization of your API credentials.

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description: Filter by payment method (e.g., CARD, PIX).

200.description: The routings configured on the account, or an empty array if it has none.

name.example: Card routing — Stripe primary, Adyen fallback

start_split.description: Splits the entry of the route across several steps by percentage. Omit to start every payment on step 1. Entries must sum to 100; returned only when the route has a split entry.

provider_id.description: Required on provider steps; absent on action steps. Must match the provider of the connection.

connection_id.description: Required on provider steps; absent on action steps. Must be ACTIVE and support the payment_method.

action.description: Makes the step an action step that ends the route: CANCEL rejects the payment, CAPTURE captures the authorization after action_delay, HOLD_FOR_REVIEW leaves it pending manual review. CAPTURE and HOLD_FOR_REVIEW must be reached only from APPROVED outputs. An action step has no provider_id, connection_id or output.

action_delay.description: Only with action = CAPTURE. ISO-8601 duration between the approval and the capture, greater than zero and at most P7D. Omit to capture as soon as the approval is processed.

status.description: APPROVED, DECLINED, DECLINE_GROUP, MAC_CODE_GROUP, SUCCEEDED_GROUP or INTERNAL_ERROR.

decline_types.description: Members of the group on DECLINE_GROUP (decline sub-statuses) and MAC_CODE_GROUP (Merchant Advice Codes) outputs.

group_id.description: Id of the group behind a DECLINE_GROUP, MAC_CODE_GROUP or SUCCEEDED_GROUP output.

group_name.description: Name of the group behind group_id. Ignored on write.

retry.description: Whether this output retries the same provider once before following next. Always returned.

next_split.description: Splits the fallback across several steps by percentage: at least 2 entries whose percentages sum to 100. Returned alongside next = first entry.

output.description: Per-outcome handlers. Returned as an empty array on action steps.

condition_type.description: See Routing Conditions for the catalog: COUNTRY, CARD_ISSUER_COUNTRY, AMOUNT, CARD_TYPE, CARD_BRAND, CARD_BIN, TRANSACTION_TYPE, METADATA, ADDITIONAL_FIELD, TIME_PERIOD, VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT.

values.description: Empty only on an AMOUNT condition with currency, which then matches any amount in that currency.

key.description: METADATA: the metadata key. ADDITIONAL_FIELD: the supported field name.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Required on AMOUNT and on VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT with limit_by = VOLUME.

time_period_repeat_amount.description: TIME_PERIOD and VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: every how many units of time_period_repeat_frequency (schedule), or the length of a DAILY window in days, 1 to 90 (limit).

time_period_repeat_frequency.description: TIME_PERIOD: recurrence unit. VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: period of the limit, DAILY, MONTHLY or QUARTERLY.

time_period_repetition_days.description: TIME_PERIOD only. Days of the week the schedule applies to; needs a frequency.

time_period_start_time.description: TIME_PERIOD only. Start of the daily time window (HH:mm:ss), together with time_period_end_time.

time_period_end_time.description: TIME_PERIOD only. End of the daily time window (HH:mm:ss), inclusive.

timezone.description: UTC offset. TIME_PERIOD: offset the schedule is read in (defaults to the offset of values[0]). VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: whole-hour offset where periods start (defaults to +00:00).

limit_by.description: VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT only. Count payments (default) or sum amounts in currency.

payments_count.description: VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT only. Which payments count toward the limit. Default ALL.

conditions.description: Conditions combined with logical AND. See Routing Conditions.

route.description: Same shape as default_route, including start_split, output[].next_split and action steps.

400.description: Bad Request. `ROUTING_VALIDATION_FAILED` when `account_id` is missing, `INVALID_ACCOUNT_ID` when it belongs to a different organization.
